stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Modern conservation needs both personal habits and infrastructure care.”?
options: Sometimes a small change helps more people than we first think.
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
A responsible community checks the pipes as well as the people.
A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.
